Welcome to the official YouTube channel for Purr Partners Feline Rescue, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to saving the most at-risk cats and kittens in central North Carolina.

We focus our mission on those who need us most: felines in high-kill shelters, survivors of hoarding situations, the sick and injured, and fragile bottle babies requiring 24/7 care. By stepping in where the need is greatest, we give a voice to the vulnerable.

Why Foster-Based?
As an all-foster rescue, we don’t have a central building. Instead, our cats live in private homes with dedicated volunteers. This allows every kitty to socialize, rehabilitate, and thrive in a safe, loving environment before finding their forever family.

Join Our Mission:

Adopt: View our available cats at purrpartners.org.

Foster: Become the bridge between rescue and adoption.

Support: Your donations fund life-saving medical care.

Subscribe for rescue stories, recovery updates, and plenty of happy endings! 🐾
